title: Switch (toggle)
description: A switch enables the activation or deactivation of an assigned function. A switch always needs a unique label of the corresponding function.

notes.content: In the front-end kit, the switch is listed under the term 'toggle'.
Labeling should describe the function, not the action or state (use 'Bluetooth', not 'Bluetooth on').
Can be used without label if context makes meaning clear.

guidelines: Used individually unlike checkboxes or radio buttons.
Only for activating or deactivating a function.
Do not use for option selection – use dropdown or radio buttons instead.

usage.dont: Do not use for selecting options

support.note: Feature requests via Jira to digital expert team
